name: Paradise Citi
description: We're RV Ever After—a couple of full-time travelers who hit the road in 2019 and spent five unforgettable years exploring the USA in our RV. We visited all 48 lower states, chasing sunsets, discovering hidden gems, and learning what makes an RV stay truly special. After thousands of miles and countless memories, one thing became clear—we love the RV lifestyle, and we're passionate about creating amazing places for others to enjoy it, too. That's why we planted our roots in Gulf Shores, Alabama, and opened our own RV sites to share the magic of this area with fellow travelers. From day one, our goal has been to blend the charm of coastal living with the comforts we always looked for on the road. We're here to provide a smooth experience for every guest—and we can't wait to welcome you to Paradise Citi. Our small, private property offers a peaceful, upscale escape for RV travelers seeking a mix of comfort, style, and prime location. Located near the intersection of Highway 59 and County Road 8, Paradise Citi offers a quiet and convenient base to explore everything the Gulf Coast has to offer. With its sugar-white sand beaches, peaceful campgrounds, friendly locals, and stunning Gulf Coast sunsets, this coastal gem offers the perfect blend of relaxation and exploration.
